key.description: the format key exactly as in display.formats

effects.description: every effect of this function on the signer, from the code: one plain sentence each

shown.description: one sentence: what the screen tells the signer

title.description: one sentence, at most 20 words: the function and what is wrong

evidence.description: the code line(s) and descriptor text it rests on, with file and function; for groundTruth, the case index and the effect

groundTruth.description: true only when a mined transaction's effects (cases/*.json) show it

cases.description: one per test case of this format that has mined effects

signerEffects.description: how many distinct effects on the signer the mined tx had (merge the same asset and direction)

shownRight.description: how many of those the screen states right (asset, amount or bound, party)

reader.description: for each signer effect, how the blind reader understood it

glance.description: intent + interpolated intent alone: how well a non-expert knows what happens (100 = fully, no surprise)

depth.description: the fields: how well someone who reads all of them can verify every effect

couldNotCheck.description: what kept you from checking an effect: missing source, unresolved proxy. Empty when nothing did.
